item.tib: rnam dag pad ma yum gyi 'phrin las rgyas pa'i gzhung gi cho ga
item.coloph: rnam dag yum gyi 'phrin las 'di/ rgyal ba'i yum lung dang bla ma'i gsung bzhin du/ gong 'og ma nor 'phrin las khrigs su sdeb (bsdebs)/ dge des 'gro kun sangs rgyas myur thob shog de ltar rnam dag pad ma yum gyi 'phrin las chog khrigs dang bcas pa 'di ni/ g.yas ru bru ston rgyal ba g.yung drung la/ dad ldan gyi slob ma 'ga' yis bskul ngor/ dpal ldan mkhar sna'i dgon du sbyar ba rdzogs so//
